learning_outcomes.text: Ability to classify and define membrane types and membrane processes.
Having knowledge about industrial applications of membrane processes.
Ability to perform mass transfer analysis in different types of membranes.
Ability to work individually and in a group.
Ability to communicate in written and oral form and to improve oneself by following technological advancements.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Membrane Science and Technology
Overview of Membrane Science, Membrane Types and Preparation Methods
Membrane Transport Theory: Solution-Diffusion Model, Pore Flow Model
Membrane Transport Theory and Transport Models: Series Resistance Model, Boundary Film Layer Model
Hybrid Membrane Processes, Fuel Cells, Membrane Contactors and Applications
